title: FloodGuard Companion Discount on Limit Increases: HomeGuard at the Same Address
content:
**Companion discount on a limit increase — FloodGuard Private Flood Policy.** The increase companion discount is the tier's companion discount percentage plus 3 percentage points when a HomeGuard Homeowners Policy of the customer at the same property address was in force on the date the increase was requested, meaning bound on or before that date and not cancelled or expired by it, and had then been in force since its original effective date for at least 60 months; the tier's companion discount percentage when such a HomeGuard policy was in force on the request date but for fewer than 60 months; and no discount when no HomeGuard policy at the same property address was in force on the request date. The discount reduces the additional premium charged for the limit increase by that percentage.

**Records read.** From the flood policy's limit-increase entry, the request date. From the customer's HomeGuard Homeowners Policy at the flood policy's property address: whether and when it was bound, whether it had been cancelled or had expired by the request date (its end date), and its original effective date. The HomeGuard tenure is the whole calendar months from its original effective date to the request date.

| HomeGuard at the same address on the request date | Tenure to the request date | Increase companion discount |
|---|---|---|
| In force | 60 months or more | tier's companion discount percentage plus 3 |
| In force | fewer than 60 months | tier's companion discount percentage |
| Not in force (not yet bound, or cancelled or expired by that date), or none held | — | none |

**Resulting percentages by tier** (a direct reading of the rule with each tier's companion discount percentage):

| Tier | Fewer than 60 months | 60 months or more |
|---|---|---|
| FloodGuard Contents Only | 5 | 8 |
| FloodGuard Essential | 5 | 8 |
| FloodGuard Standard | 5 | 8 |
| FloodGuard Plus | 7 | 10 |
| FloodGuard Premier | 7 | 10 |
| FloodGuard High Value | 10 | 13 |

**Hypothetical cases** (request date 2025-06-10, FloodGuard Plus):

- HomeGuard at the same address in force, original effective date 2020-06-10: 60 months to the request date, so 10 percent.
- HomeGuard at the same address in force, original effective date 2020-07-01: 59 whole months, so 7 percent.
- HomeGuard at the same address cancelled on 2025-06-01: not in force on the request date, so no discount.
- HomeGuard at the same address bound on 2025-06-15: not bound by the request date, so no discount.
- HomeGuard at the same address cancelled on 2025-06-20, original effective date 2018-01-01: it was still in force on the request date, with more than 60 months, so 10 percent.
